english.title: Fail to inform change in ownership / occupation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of land, namely **(..SPECIFY LAND..), included in a site of special scientific interest,

(A)_[disposed of your interest in the land and failed to send a notice to English Nature informing them of your disposal within 28 days beginning with the date on which you disposed of the land]_
(B)_[disposed of your interest in the land and failed to send a notice to the Natural Resources Body for Wales informing them of your disposal within 28 days beginning with the date on which you disposed of the land]_
(C)_[became aware that the land was occupied by an additional occupier, namely **(..SPECIFY OCCUPIER..), and failed to send a notice to English Nature informing them of the details of the additional occupier within 28 days beginning with the date on which you became aware of that occupier]_
(D)_[became aware that the land was occupied by an additional occupier, namely **(..SPECIFY OCCUPIER..), and failed to send a notice to the Natural Resources Body for Wales informing them of the details of the additional occupier within 28 days beginning with the date on which you became aware of that occupier]_
(E)_[became aware that the land was occupied by a different occupier, namely **(..SPECIFY OCCUPIER..), and failed to send a notice to English Nature informing them of the details of the new occupier within 28 days beginning with the date on which you became aware of the change in occupier]_
(F)_[became aware that the land was occupied by a different occupier, namely **(..SPECIFY OCCUPIER..), and failed to send a notice to the Natural Resources Body for Wales informing them of the details of the new occupier within 28 days beginning with the date on which you became aware of the change in occupier]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 28Q(4) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Methu â hysbysu o newid i' berchnogaeth / feddiannaeth

(A)_[gael gwared â'ch buddiant yn y tir a methu anfon hysbysiad i English Nature i roi gwybod iddynt eich bod yn gwaredu o fewn 28 diwrnod o ddyddiad y gwaredasoch â'r tir]_
